NAVAREA XIX 130/26
The following NAVAREA XIX warnings are in effect as of 232047 UTC on October 26: 114, 128, 129, 130.
NAVAREA XIX warning 125/26 is cancelled.

NAVAREA XIX 114/261. The Norwegian government has decided that Russian fishing vessels are only allowed to enter three ports on the Norwegian mainland:
A. Båtsfjord (NOBJF)
B. Kirkenes (NOKKN)
C. Tromsø (NOTOS)
Entry to all other ports on the Norwegian mainland is prohibited for Russian fishing vessels from 132200 UTC October 2022. NAVAREA XIX 45/26 is cancelled.
